description.zh: 六边形长期记忆插件 · v1.1.0 AI 智能版：由当前对话模型语义判断哪些信息值得长期记住（不再依赖固定句式），支持类型/重要性/敏感/空间自动判定、冲突检测、艾宾浩斯复习、注入预算优化与液态玻璃管理面板。零外部依赖，无需 API Key。
description.en: Hexagon long-term memory plugin v1.1.0 with AI judgement: the current chat model decides what is worth remembering (no fixed regex needed), with auto type/importance/sensitive/space tagging, conflict detection, Ebbinghaus review, injection budget tuning and a liquid-glass panel. No external API key required.
